The top-level scope contains only benign variable assignments: package metadata (pkgname, pkgver, pkgrel, pkgdesc, arch, url, license), dependency arrays (depends, optdepends, makedepends), source, and sha256sums. No command substitution, eval, network calls, file modifications, or other dangerous operations at this scope.

**build()/package()**: These functions reference the standard Python build/installer workflow (`python -m build --wheel --no-isolation` and `python -m installer --destdir="$pkgdir" dist/*.whl`), but they will not execute during this gate due to `--nobuild` and `--noprepare`. They are out of scope here.

There is no evidence of injected malicious code, obfuscation, or exfiltration behavior at the top level or in the source definitions.
</details>
